scope: Curated manuscript sources, bilingual PDFs, presentation and complete public Introduction sentence mapping
manifest_policy: MANIFEST.json lists every curated member except itself; all members including metadata are tracked and checked against the final Git tree.
scientific_acceptance: usable-with-scope; descriptive comparisons only, no causal, noninferiority or matched quality-cost benefit
validation_scope: 20 referenced figure pages plus 30 document pages compared separately from 17 presentation pages; see independent repair receipt for final tree identity validation.
public_privacy: Complete editorial sentence mapping included. Private review records, internal workflow records and third-party reference PDFs excluded. Existing source-data manifests retain their previously published path metadata.
